body: Talked it over with Keith. Sept 14 kickoff keeps us clear of the home games and the October conference. Locking it in.
Works for me. That gives us all summer to get the rest of this lined up. Good to go.
Keep the application short. Folks won't fill out a long form. Name, company, years in freight, and what they want out of it is plenty.
Agreed. I've got a rough draft going in Google Forms. Will send it around this week for a look.
Called the Volunteer Conference Center. Reserved the small meeting room for the 14th, seats 25, projector included.
Perfect, thank you Bren. Go ahead and put down the deposit.
Let's hold off on a logo and banner this first year. Keep it simple, see how it goes. Marking this canceled.
I'll ask Roy and that fellow from the TN Freight Association board. Both have been brokering longer than me.
I've got two more I can lean on. Between us we should have four solid mentors lined up.
Sheet is mostly built. Adding a status column for new, reviewing, accepted, and waitlist. Will share once it's tidy.
Draft flyer looks good. Just soften the headline a touch and add the website. Otherwise approved.
Eight to ten feels right for year one. Big enough to be worth it, small enough we can give everybody real attention.
Same page. Cap it at ten and waitlist anybody after that.
Biweekly is my vote. Everybody's running their own shop, weekly is too much to ask. Tuesday evenings worked at the chamber group.
Tuesday evenings it is. I'll block the Volunteer Conference Center room for the biweekly Tuesdays through the fall.
Good. Once you've got names, send them to Bren so she can put together the mentor packet and the welcome email.
Sheet looks great Bren. Add a column for which mentor each mentee is paired with and we're set.
Softened the headline and dropped the website at the bottom. Sending the final to print this week.
Filled out the draft form myself to test it. Took two minutes, felt right. Go ahead and share it with Keith for a look.
Cap at ten, waitlist the rest. Bren, go ahead and note that on the tracker sheet so we all see the same number.
